# Minor 15.2 Migration guide — agent instructions

> [!NOTE]
> Machine-oriented companion to [15.2.md](./15.2.md). The human-facing rationale lives there; this file contains the detection commands and the exact edits to apply.

Scope: Renovate configuration only.
**No application source change is required by this version line**, so do not edit `.ts`, `.html`, or `.scss` files for this migration.

## Task 1 — Deduplicate the `generatorDependencies` custom manager

The Otter `base` preset now ships a custom regex manager that updates the `generatorDependencies` block of `package.json`.
It is defined in [`otter-generator-dependencies.json5`](https://github.com/AmadeusITGroup/otter/blob/main/tools/renovate/managers/otter-generator-dependencies.json5).
A repository-local manager doing the same job now produces duplicate extractions, and therefore duplicate branches and pull requests per bump.

### Detect

Renovate configuration can live in any of these locations, so check all of them:

```
renovate.json  renovate.json5  .renovaterc  .renovaterc.json  .renovaterc.json5
.github/renovate.json  .github/renovate.json5
.gitlab/renovate.json  .gitlab/renovate.json5
```

The configuration may also be inlined under a `renovate` key in the root `package.json`.

```bash
# Locate the Renovate configuration
ls -1 renovate.json* .renovaterc* .github/renovate.json* .gitlab/renovate.json* 2>/dev/null
node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); if (p.renovate) console.log('inlined in package.json')"

# Does it declare a generatorDependencies manager?
grep -rn "generatorDependencies" --include="renovate.json*" --include=".renovaterc*" --include="package.json" . | grep -v node_modules
```

Also confirm whether the repository extends the Otter `base` preset at all:

```bash
grep -rn "AmadeusITGroup/otter//tools/renovate/base" --include="renovate.json*" --include=".renovaterc*" . | grep -v node_modules
```

### Decide

| Finding | Action |
|---|---|
| Extends Otter `base` **and** has a local `generatorDependencies` manager | Remove the local manager (see *Apply*) |
| Extends Otter `base`, no local manager | No action |
| Does **not** extend Otter `base`, has a local manager | No action, as the local manager is still the only coverage. Report it |
| Does **not** extend Otter `base`, no local manager | No action. Optionally report that `generatorDependencies` is uncovered |

### Apply

Delete the matching entry from the `customManagers` array, or from the deprecated `regexManagers` array.
The entry to remove is the one whose `matchStrings` reference `generatorDependencies`, typically shaped like:

```json5
{
  "customType": "regex",
  "fileMatch": ["(^|/)package\\.json$"],
  "matchStringsStrategy": "recursive",
  "matchStrings": [
    "\"generatorDependencies\"\\s*:\\s*\\{[^}]*\\}",
    "\"(?<depName>[^\"]+)\"\\s*:\\s*\"(?<currentValue>[^\"]+)\""
  ],
  "datasourceTemplate": "npm"
}
```

Rules:
- If the array becomes empty after removal, remove the now-empty `customManagers` or `regexManagers` key as well.
- **Preserve any non-overlapping behaviour.** Do not silently drop a distinct `versioningTemplate`, a narrower `fileMatch`, a `registryUrlTemplate`, or grouping and scheduling options.
  Re-express it as a `packageRules` entry keyed on the `depType` the Otter preset sets:

  ```json5
  {
    "packageRules": [
      {
        "matchDepTypes": ["generatorDependencies"],
        "groupName": "Otter generator dependencies"
      }
    ]
  }
  ```
- Stop and ask the user if the local manager targets blocks other than `generatorDependencies` in the same entry, because removing it wholesale would lose that coverage.

## Task 2 — Enable `custom.regex` when `enabledManagers` is restricted

`enabledManagers` is an allow-list: when present, Renovate runs only the listed managers.
Every Otter manager preset is a [custom regex manager](https://docs.renovatebot.com/modules/manager/regex/), exposed under the single manager id `custom.regex`.
That covers `otter-generator-dependencies`, `github-node-version`, `mcp-servers`, and `renovate-otter-presets`.
Without it, the presets still resolve but none of their managers run, so no update is ever raised.

### Detect

```bash
grep -rn "enabledManagers" --include="renovate.json*" --include=".renovaterc*" --include="package.json" . | grep -v node_modules
```

### Decide

| Finding | Action |
|---|---|
| `enabledManagers` absent | No action, as all managers are enabled by default |
| `enabledManagers` present, already contains `custom.regex` | No action |
| `enabledManagers` present, missing `custom.regex` | Add it (see *Apply*) |
| `enabledManagers` present, contains the legacy `regex` id | Replace `regex` with `custom.regex` |

### Apply

Append `custom.regex` to the existing array, preserving the other entries:

```json5
{
  "enabledManagers": [
    "npm",
    "github-actions",
    "custom.regex"
  ]
}
```

## Verify

```bash
# Validate the resulting configuration
npx --yes --package renovate -- renovate-config-validator
```

Confirm the following without applying further changes:
- No `generatorDependencies` custom manager remains in the repository configuration when the Otter `base` preset is extended.
- `custom.regex` is present in `enabledManagers` if and only if that key exists.

## Report

State for each task whether it was detected, not applicable, or applied, and list the configuration files touched.
If Task 1 was skipped because the repository does not extend the Otter `base` preset, say so explicitly, since the local manager is intentionally kept.
